text: {"name":"parse_channel_definition","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Extracts a Wi-Fi channel number and derives band, frequency, and secondary-channel settings from the input buffer.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"a1":"input","a2":"input_len","a3":"primary_channel_out","a4":"channel_config_out","v14":"channel_number","v16":"primary_frequency_mhz","v18":"secondary_channel_offset"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Band selector; set when the channel number is greater than 14."},{"offset":1,"meaning":"Indicates a valid secondary-channel offset for 40 MHz operation."},{"offset":2,"meaning":"Primary channel frequency in MHz."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Center frequency in MHz; adjusted by 10 MHz for a secondary-channel offset."}]}
